name: Asian Paints

snapshot.about: Asian Paints exists to beautify, transform and preserve spaces and objects, bringing happiness to the world.

narrative: Management promised mid-single-digit value growth and 18 to 20 percent PBDIT margins for FY26. Numbers agreed, as decorative value grew 4.3 percent while consolidated PBDIT margin hit 18.9 percent. Q1 FY27 continued strong momentum with revenue up 18 percent.

promises.statement: Management expects mid-single-digit value growth for full year FY26.

said.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management targets maintaining an 18% to 20% PBDIT margin band.

said.quote: it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management expects volume growth to be in the band of 8% to 10%.

said.quote: No, I think I have been maintaining that, as I said that, band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator

actual_source.quote: On a yearly level, volume growth is close to about 9%, which is quite commendable, and the value growth is about 4.3%

promises.note: Full year FY26 decorative volume grew close to 9 percent, matching the targeted 8 to 10 percent range.

promises.statement: Management guides PBDIT margins to remain between 18% and 20%.

said.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain

actual_source.quote: PBDIT grew in double-digits, and PBDIT margins at 18.9%, higher by almost 110 bps

promises.note: Consolidated PBDIT margin for FY26 was 18.9 percent, meeting the 18 to 20 percent guidance band.

promises.statement: Company expects high single-digit volume growth of 8% to 10% in FY27.

said.quote: We are looking at the price increases that are happening and trying to see that we get into that area of 8-10% volume growth

actual_source.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth

promises.note: Decorative volume grew 9 percent in Q1 FY27, aligning with full-year guidance of 8 to 10 percent.

promises.statement: Company aims to maintain its PBDIT margin guidance band of 18% to 20%.

said.quote: Just to understand clearly that in doing so, you would like to maintain your margin guidance, which has always been 18-20%

bull.point: Operating cash flows effectively converted all reported net profits into cash across FY22 to FY26.

bull.point: Consolidated revenue growth reached 18 percent in Q1 FY27, backed by 9 percent volume growth in decorative paints.

evidence.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth
In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth

bull.point: International business registered strong top-line growth of 27 percent in Q1 FY27 with expanding PBT margins.

evidence.quote: We have grown at about 27% in Q1
which comes in with a PBT margin of about 7.9%, which is higher by 275 bps

bear.point: The Competition Commission of India initiated an investigation against the company over alleged abuse of market dominance.

evidence.quote: directing the Director General (DG) to conduct an investigation against the Company under the provisions of the Competition Act, 2002

bear.point: Revenue recognition cut-off was highlighted as a key audit matter due to the susceptibility of results to material misstatement.
